name: hand_start_id
description: Primary key. Foreign key to hand_starts.hand_start_id. hand_actions is 1:1 with hand_starts, so the parent id is the primary key — there is no separate hand_action_id. Also the natural key for this table's replace-semantics writes.

name: hand_setup_id
description: Denormalized grandparent hand setup identifier. Equals hand_starts.hand_setup_id for this hand start; stored to give the assembly phase a direct join to hand_setups.

name: clip_id
description: Denormalized parent clip identifier. Equals hand_starts.clip_id for this hand start; stored to avoid joins on common queries.

name: video_id
description: Denormalized parent video identifier. Equals hand_starts.video_id for this hand start; stored to avoid joins on common queries.

name: hand_action_state
description: Observed action sequence, community cards, and outcome for the hand. Structure: {hand_start: {...verbatim copy of hand_starts.hand_start_state}, streets: [{street_name: string, street_timestamp: int|null, community_cards: [string], extraction_status: string, actions: [{action_order: int, seat_position_label: string, action_type: string, bet_amount: number|null}]}], winning_positions: [string]}. street_timestamp is an offset from the start of the source video in whole seconds, and is null for preflop (there is no card-reveal moment). The embedded hand_start is a snapshot taken at write time; reprocessing Phase 4 does not update it. The provenance key is a sibling of this phase's own contribution and records the models that served each call mode and the git blob hash of every prompt file and reference image that contributed to this row. extraction_status is why community_cards are what they are: 'not_applicable' preflop, 'extracted' when step E located and read the street, 'skipped_inert' when betting had already closed so the cards carry no decisions and were deliberately not scanned, and 'unread' which is defined for completeness but never written — an unread contested street fails the attempt instead.

name: street_frame_gcs_paths
description: Full gs://... URIs to the frames extracted shortly after each postflop street's reveal timestamp, one per street whose extraction_status is 'extracted', ordered flop then turn then river. Shorter than the streets array whenever a street was skipped as inert, so the two are not positionally aligned — map a path to its street by the street name in its filename, never by index. Empty for a hand that ended preflop. Never NULL — an empty repeated column is an empty array.

name: detected_at
description: Timestamp when this hand action row was written. Auto-populated on insert via DEFAULT.
